  "reasons": [
    "Marginal utility is defined as the change in total utility resulting from consuming one additional unit of a good (MU_n = TU_n - TU_{n-1}).",
    "Here, TU rises from 28 units after 4 units to 30 units after 5 units, so MU of the 5th unit is 30 - 28 = 2 units."
  ],

    {

      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "Clearly, consumption of the 5th banana has caused total utility to increase by 2 units (30 units minus 28 units). Therefore, marginal utility of the 5th banana is 2 units.",
